T1: Turn 1 asks for the actual case instead of judging feasibility vs desirability itself.

T1: No narration of technique, just direct questioning.
T1: Short, direct, no hedging, ends on a sharp question.

T2: Correctly applies technical specifics (soft-delete pattern, versioning layer) to test the feasibility claim.

T2: Turn runs to three dense paragraphs, longer than the ~1-2 short paragraph target.

[held] T3: Gives a new structural breakdown (three hiding places for 'not feasible') and demands the visitor produce the first question.

T3: Multi-paragraph explanatory turn exceeds the short, phone-readable register the voice calls for.
T4: "That's exactly the right question, genuinely, don't undersell it" directly confirms the visitor's answer as correct.
